comparison.objective: Recover finishing media with a screen vs measure brake-rotor thickness with a micrometer.
comparison.physical_skill: Pouring and bounded agitation of a loaded screen vs square tool placement, precision thimble/ratchet adjustment, and reading preservation.
comparison.success_condition: ≥98% media recovery and all washers retained vs ±0.02 mm thickness reading, ratchet clicks, tool removal, and return to its rest.
comparison.reason: The record is precision metrology, not material separation.
